title: Comedy Show
description: Find a comedy show, grab a drink or snack, and spend the night laughing together.

title: Live Music
description: Find a local band or artist, head out together, and enjoy some live music.

title: Cooking Class
description: Take a cooking class together and learn how to make something completely new.

title: Escape Room
description: Work as a team to solve the clues and see if you can escape before the clock runs out.

title: Kayaking
description: Rent a kayak or canoe and spend some time exploring the water together.

title: Botanical Garden
description: Wander through a botanical garden together and find your favourite hidden corner.

title: Breakfast Picnic
description: Pick up breakfast favourites, find a peaceful spot, and start the day outside together.

title: Make Pizza Together
description: Choose your toppings, make pizzas from scratch, and see whose creation turns out best.

title: Karaoke Night
description: Pick a few songs, sing badly or brilliantly, and cheer each other on.

title: Be Tourists in Your Own City
description: Pick one place nearby you have always walked past and finally explore it together.

title: Record Store Date
description: Browse a record store together and each choose an album or song for the other person.

title: Library Date
description: Wander through the shelves and pick out something interesting for each other to read.

title: Roller Skating
description: Hit a roller rink together, hold hands when you wobble, and enjoy a playful night out.

title: Ice Skating
description: Go ice skating together and see who can stay upright the longest.

title: Food Truck Crawl
description: Visit a few food trucks and share something small from each one.

title: Cocktail or Mocktail Night
description: Choose a couple of fun drink recipes and make your own little tasting night at home.

title: Puzzle Night
description: Pick a puzzle, put on some music, and spend the evening working on it together.

title: Campfire Night
description: Light a campfire or fire pit, bring something warm to drink, and spend the evening talking.

title: Flower Market Date
description: Wander through a flower market together and choose a favourite bunch to take home.

title: Scenic Drive
description: Pick a beautiful route, make a playlist, and stop somewhere interesting along the way.

title: DIY Project Together
description: Choose a small project for your home and spend the date making something together.

title: Aquarium Date
description: Explore an aquarium together and each pick the creature you think best matches the other.

title: Trivia Night
description: Join a local trivia night and see how well your combined random knowledge can do.

title: Dress-Up Dinner
description: Get properly dressed up and turn an ordinary dinner into a special night out together.
